title: 一个元素生成整个群
One generator, the whole group
text: 若某个 a 的整数幂遍历 G，则 G 为循环群，a 为生成元。加法记号下，幂 aᵏ 对应整数倍 ka。循环群必交换。
A cyclic group consists of all integer powers of one element. In additive notation powers become integer multiples. Every cyclic group is abelian.
example: ℤ is generated by 1 or −1. In ℤ₆, [1] and [5] generate the whole group, while [2] generates only three elements.

title: 元素的阶与幂的重复
Element order and repeated powers
text: 元素的阶是使 aⁿ=e 的最小正整数 n；若不存在，则为无穷阶。有限阶时 aⁱ=aʲ 当且仅当 n 整除 i−j。
The order of a is the least positive n with aⁿ=e, or infinity if none exists. For finite order n, two powers agree exactly when their exponents are congruent modulo n.
proof: 若 n 整除 k，直接用 aⁿ=e 得 aᵏ=e。
If n divides k, aᵏ=e follows from aⁿ=e.
反向用带余除法 k=qn+r，0≤r<n。若 aᵏ=e，则 aʳ=e。
Conversely write k=qn+r with 0≤r<n. Then aᵏ=e implies aʳ=e.
由 n 的最小性得 r=0。对 aⁱ=aʲ 两边乘 a⁻ʲ 即得幂的相等判别。
Minimality forces r=0. Apply this to aⁱ⁻ʲ to characterize equality of powers.

title: 循环群的分类
Classification of cyclic groups
text: 循环群由生成元的阶完全决定：只有无限循环群和每个正整数阶的有限循环群两种情形。
The order of a generator completely determines a cyclic group: infinite cyclic, or cyclic of order n for a positive integer n.
proof: 无穷阶时定义 f:ℤ→⟨a⟩，k↦aᵏ。它保持加法到乘法，并且满射。
For infinite order define f:ℤ→⟨a⟩ by k↦aᵏ. It preserves the operation and is surjective.
若 aⁱ=aʲ 且 i≠j，就产生非零整数次幂等于 e，与无穷阶矛盾；故 f 单射。
If aⁱ=aʲ with i≠j, a nonzero power is the identity, contradicting infinite order. Thus f is injective.
有限阶 n 时改定义 [k]↦aᵏ。幂的重复判别同时保证良定义与单射；满射和保运算仍然成立。
For order n use [k]↦aᵏ. The criterion for equal powers proves both well-definedness and injectivity; surjectivity and compatibility remain true.

title: 循环群的子群
Subgroups of cyclic groups
text: 循环群的每个子群都循环。若 |a|=n，对每个正因子 m∣n，恰有一个 m 阶子群 ⟨aⁿ⁄ᵐ⟩。
Every subgroup of a cyclic group is cyclic. If |a|=n, for every positive divisor m of n there is exactly one subgroup of order m, namely ⟨aⁿ⁄ᵐ⟩.
proof: H={e} 时显然。否则取最小正整数 d，使 aᵈ∈H。
The trivial subgroup is cyclic. Otherwise choose the least positive d with aᵈ∈H.
若 aᵏ∈H，写 k=qd+r，0≤r<d，则 aʳ=aᵏ(aᵈ)⁻ᑫ∈H。最小性给出 r=0，故 H=⟨aᵈ⟩。
Divide k by d. The remainder power aʳ belongs to H, so minimality forces r=0; hence H=⟨aᵈ⟩.
有限阶时对 n 做同样的除法，得 d∣n；⟨aᵈ⟩ 恰有 n/d 个元素。指定阶 m 就确定 d=n/m。
For finite order, dividing n by d gives d∣n. The subgroup has n/d elements, so its order m uniquely determines d=n/m.

title: 幂的阶与生成元
Orders of powers and generators
text: 设 |a|=n。求 aᵏ 的阶，就是求使 n∣kt 的最小正整数 t。于是 n 阶循环群的生成元有 φ(n) 个。
For |a|=n, the order of aᵏ is the least positive t with n∣kt. Consequently, a cyclic group of order n has φ(n) generators.
proof: 令 d=gcd(n,k)，n=dn₀，k=dk₀，且 gcd(n₀,k₀)=1。
Put d=gcd(n,k), n=dn₀ and k=dk₀ with coprime n₀,k₀.
(aᵏ)ᵗ=e ⇔ n∣kt ⇔ n₀∣k₀t ⇔ n₀∣t。最后一步用互素性。
The condition (aᵏ)ᵗ=e is equivalent to n₀∣k₀t, and hence to n₀∣t by coprimality.
最小正 t=n₀=n/d；生成整个群等价于阶为 n，即 d=1。
The least t is n/d. It generates the whole group exactly when d=1.

title: 一个算术应用
An arithmetic application
text: Cₙ 的自同构由生成元的像唯一决定：a↦aᵏ 必须把生成元送到生成元，即 gcd(k,n)=1。
An automorphism of Cₙ is determined by the image of a generator. Sending a to aᵏ works precisely when k is coprime to n.
proof: 保持乘法的映射由 f(a) 确定，且 f(aʲ)=f(a)ʲ。若 f 为同构，f(a) 必生成全群。
A homomorphism is determined by f(a). For an automorphism, f(a) must generate the group.
每个互素 k 给出良定义双射 f_k(aʲ)=aᵏʲ。复合满足 f_k∘f_l=f_(kl)，因此自同构群对应于模 n 的单位群。
Each coprime k defines a bijection f_k(aʲ)=aᵏʲ. Composition multiplies k modulo n, giving the unit group.
example: C₈ 有 4 个自同构，对应 k=1,3,5,7；这个自同构群本身不是循环群。
C₈ has four automorphisms, corresponding to k=1,3,5,7. This automorphism group is not cyclic.

question: ℤ₁₂ 的全部生成元是？
Which are all generators of ℤ₁₂?
reason: 生成元对应与 12 互素的剩余类，共 φ(12)=4 个。
Generators are precisely the residues coprime to 12.

question: 12 阶循环群有几个 4 阶子群？
How many subgroups of order 4 does C₁₂ have?
reason: 循环群对群阶的每个正因子都有唯一对应阶子群，这里为 ⟨a³⟩。
There is a unique subgroup for each divisor; here it is ⟨a³⟩.

question: 哪条推论正确？
Which implication is correct?
options: 子群只有有限个 ⇒ 循环
reason: 同一元素的幂两两交换；反向可用 C₂×C₂ 否定。
Powers of one element commute. C₂×C₂ refutes the converse.

question: 证明：ℤ 的任一非零子群都恰为 dℤ，其中 d 是唯一正整数。
Prove every nonzero subgroup of ℤ is dℤ for a unique positive integer d.
reason: 取子群的最小正元素 d。对任意 h，用带余除法 h=qd+r；r=h−qd 仍在子群，0≤r<d，故 r=0。反向 d 的整数倍都在子群。最小正元素的唯一性给出 d 唯一。
Choose the least positive d in the subgroup. Division with remainder forces every h to be divisible by d. All multiples of d belong, and the least positive element is unique.

label: 应用与补充
Arithmetic application
units.note: 单位群的算术例子；这里不把单位群的任意性质标成“模素数单位群循环”的定理 1.5.3。
